name: POST /api/leadflow/meetings/:id/reschedule - move it, keeping exactly one active event
description:
THE ACCEPTANCE TEST IS RESCHEDULING TWICE (327ca5f6-1d99-4b2c-9e2a-218250f64f45#AC1), and it was MEASURED: after two reschedules the meeting held active_event_ref evt-3 with superseded_event_count 2, and each reschedule suppressed 3 reminders and created 3. Exactly one active event and one reminder set, however many times it is called.

THE PREVIOUS INVITE IS CANCELLED AND ARCHIVED, never left live. Two active invitations means the customer holds two and turns up to neither - and the archived refs stay readable, so "which invite did they accept" is answerable afterwards.

THE REMINDER SET IS REGENERATED WHOLESALE rather than adjusted. A partial update can leave one reminder pointing at the old time, and a customer told the wrong hour by a stale reminder is the exact failure this rule prevents. Suppressing then rebuilding cannot half-succeed into that state.

QA: depends on register and login.

testCases.name: Rescheduling an unknown meeting is refused
NEGATIVE: an unparseable new time is refused
NEGATIVE: no Authorization header at all
NEGATIVE: a bearer token that does not verify

errorCases.message: starts_at must be a valid ISO timestamp
errorCases.when: the new time cannot be parsed.

errorCases.message: Authorization header with a bearer token is required
errorCases.when: the Authorization header is absent, empty, or uses a scheme other than Bearer.

errorCases.message: Session token is invalid or expired
errorCases.when: a Bearer token was presented but does not verify.
